title: Step 5: Count the Clicks
goal: Make expand count hits per code, and add top(n) returning [code, hits] pairs, busiest first.

tests.label: Counts hits
tests.expr: [list(x) for x in (lambda s: [s.shorten('http://a.com'), s.shorten('http://b.com'), s.expand('1'), s.expand('1'), s.expand('2'), s.top(2)][5])(Shortener())]

hints: Keep a dict code to count, updated when expand finds a link.
socratic: What should this new piece take in, and give back?
Which earlier piece can you reuse?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
